observations: Photo 0: An assembled treadle sewing machine - black machine head mounted on a wooden table with two drawers, decorative gold scrollwork on the head, cast-iron treadle base with belt wheel, set on tiled floor against a patterned wall.

Photo 1: A similar wooden treadle table/cabinet (no machine head mounted) standing on a paved outdoor area near a parked car; a sealed cardboard box labeled 'SEWING MACHINE HEAD ... MADE IN CHINA' sits on top of the table.
No clear brand or model name is legible on the machine head in photo 0 or on the box in photo 1.
The two photos appear to show different states: one assembled unit, one disassembled table with a boxed head - unclear if they are the same item or two different items being offered.
